_comment: Fragment 49 — D-95: the omitted Judge packet. Manifest parser repaired, phase states normalized, C-17 and C-19 installed. Merged 2026-08-22.

nodes.label: D-95 — The Omitted Judge Packet
nodes.description: The full Judge review issued against eb1549d never reached the handoff channel. Lane A saw only the DEFER row and answered the two entries in front of it. B-006 is the durable parent record of the omitted packet and B-007 through B-010 carry its independent child items.
nodes.rationale: All ten of B-006's items were verified against the artifacts before any was accepted, and all ten stand. That verification mattered: one of the five entries turned out to require a Chief Editor decision Lane A must not make, which is only visible after reading rather than agreeing.

nodes.label: A Control Installed to Stop a Silent Gap Had One
nodes.description: phase-manifest anchored a single backticked path immediately before the closing pipe, so a cell naming three paths matched nothing. The manifest declared five exclusion rows and the check reported three. A row that failed to parse produced silence rather than a finding.
nodes.rationale: The precise defect the check had been installed one pass earlier to prevent, occurring in the check itself. Fixed by collecting every backticked path in the first cell, and a first cell naming no path is now reported rather than skipped.

nodes.label: D-94 Replaced Four Contradictions With a Fifth
nodes.description: The phase-start rule said a phase begins after the preceding Judge boundary is accepted, and then said a commit predating any acceptance started Phase 2. The normalized state is that unauthorized Lane B implementation activity occurred and Phase 2 was never validly opened.
nodes.rationale: The commit stands as immutable history and only its interpretation is corrected, which is the only correction an append-only record permits. Phase 1 was never reopened either, because reopening presupposes a closure that never happened.

nodes.label: Readiness Feedback, Unauthorized Activity, Valid Opening, Reopening
nodes.description: Four states that were being conflated. Only a change made after the preceding Judge boundary was accepted opens a phase, and only a phase that previously closed can be reopened.
nodes.rationale: Conflating them is what produced the contradiction. Read-only analysis from the lane that must execute a proposal is evidence about what will deterministically fail, not permission to begin.

nodes.label: C-19 — the Deferral Reasoning Was Already Stale
nodes.description: The Reopens-Phase check was deferred because no phase had closed, which would make it vacuous, and simultaneously carried as a residual past closure. Those are incompatible. The error it catches does not require a closed phase to exist, and two entries already carried it wrongly.
nodes.rationale: Negative-tested three ways including the positive case, where a register temporarily showing a closed phase makes the same entry pass and report as a reopening.

nodes.label: C-17 — the Direction the Existing Test Could Not See
nodes.description: The application test asserts that declarations already in the code cite the config log. It cannot fail when an authoritative row is missing from the code, which is the direction where Lane A publishes a value and Lane B never implements it. config-coupling fails both ways and found thirteen real gaps on its first run.
nodes.rationale: C-17 said install it in the pass that lands build-config.ts. That pass happened and the check was not installed, so the split ownership ran a full cycle unwatched. A one-way check licenses the other direction, the lesson G65 and G71 recorded for decision-status.

nodes.label: The Red Check Is Correct
nodes.description: config-coupling reports thirteen authoritative rows with no code — the routes and the canonical sprint flags. The consistency runner is red because of them, and the red is an accurate statement that S0 is incomplete.
nodes.rationale: Softening a check that fails for a true reason would be the ceremonial-check failure this apparatus exists to catch. A check red in the normal case teaches people to ignore it; a check red because the work is not done is the gate working.

nodes.label: B-008 — Escalated, Not Decided
nodes.description: A later POC payment, cart, account and drain model whose vocabulary appears in no authoritative document. Recording it as deferred scope is consistent with the frozen set; authorizing it is a Charter-level act. Escalated to the Chief Editor at the Alpha Portfolio parent level.
nodes.rationale: NG-03 excludes monetization at Charter level and X8 removed the Stripe scaffolding. Lane A infers no authority from conversation and does not place POC commercial fields in the editorial migration.

nodes.label: C-23 — Editing an Open Decision Request Would Answer It
nodes.description: The product requirements Q11 row retains a withdrawn inference limb and still names a blocker that was decided. Both are genuinely stale and Lane A is still not correcting them, because the row states a decision request and rewriting it while the decision is open is answering it by edit.
nodes.rationale: The register simultaneously says Q11 is deferred past S1 and that it must resolve before the migration draft. Those cannot both govern the same sequence, and only a decision resolves that. Until then the staleness is recorded, visible and untouched.
